intro.paragraph: Prem-Lichtwerbung is a leading provider of premium illuminated signage and custom lighting solutions. Our innovative specialists are focused on delivering intelligent business outcomes for our clients through cutting-edge design and expert craftsmanship.

services.title: Premium
services.description: Learn how our culture of precision and creativity underpins everything we do for our clients, our partners, and the communities around us.

projects.title: FEATURED PROJECTS
projects.mainTitle: Custom LED Channel Letters for Premium Retail Brand
projects.mainDescription: We designed and installed stunning LED channel letters that elevated the brand presence of a major retail client, resulting in increased foot traffic and brand recognition.
projects.project2: High-Impact Pylon Signage for Corporate Campus
projects.project3: Neon Art Installation for Modern Restaurant Chain

expertise.title: OUR EXPERTISE
expertise.description: We are committed to delivering exceptional results through continuous innovation and expertise. From small businesses to large corporations, everyone in the Prem-Lichtwerbung family receives world-class service and premium quality solutions.

hero.title: About Us
hero.subtitle: 15 years of illuminating brands across Europe

narrative.title: Transforming
narrative.paragraph1: Since 2009, Prem-Lichtwerbung has been crafting premium illuminated signage that transforms businesses into landmarks. What started as a small workshop in Germany has grown into a leading provider of custom lighting solutions across Europe.
narrative.paragraph2: We believe every business deserves signage that not only looks incredible but performs flawlessly for years. That's why we use only the highest-quality materials, LED technology, and weatherproof construction in every project.

quality.title: Premium Quality
quality.description: We use only the highest-grade materials and LED technology. Every sign is built to last 10+ years with minimal maintenance.

custom.title: Custom Design
custom.description: Every project is unique. Our design team works with you to create signage that perfectly matches your brand identity.

turnaround.title: Fast Turnaround
turnaround.description: Most orders ready in 7-14 days. Need it faster? We offer rush production for urgent projects.

expertise.title: Proven Expertise
expertise.description: Over 500 satisfied clients across Europe trust us with their brand visibility. Join them.
